mapper.select: SELECT a.bbs01_board_id AS board_id , a.bbs01_type_cd AS type_code , f_cdnm('BoardTypeCode', a.bbs01_type_cd, a.bbs01_company_id, a.bbs01_write_date) AS type_name , a.bbs01_title AS title , a.bbs01_content AS content , a.bbs01_write_user_id AS write_user_id , f_emp_kor_nm(a.bbs01_write_user_id) || COALESCE(' ' || f.emp00_pos_nm, '') AS write_user_name , a.bbs01_write_date::date AS write_date FROM bbs01_board a LEFT OUTER JOIN emp00_trans_info f ON f.emp00_person_id = a.bbs01_write_user_id AND a.bbs01_write_date BETWEEN f.emp00_trans_date AND f.emp00_close_date WHERE a.bbs01_board_id = #{boardId} AND a.bbs01_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs01_board ( bbs01_board_id, bbs01_type_cd, bbs01_title, bbs01_content, bbs01_write_user_id, bbs01_company_id, bbs01_write_date ) VALUES ( #{req.boardId}, #{req.typeCode}, #{req.title}, #{req.content}, #{writeUserId}, #{companyId}, #{req.writeDate} )
